05 / The fit

Made to hold the laptop, too.

90 × 45 cm · target

A laptop user should be able to place the entire base on the mat and use its built-in keyboard and trackpad. An external keyboard remains a second setup choice.

  • Open left-center area for a representative 16-inch laptop base.
  • The optional charging zone at the rear-right leaves room for mouse movement.
  • NFC points and the front SenseRail remain within reach.
Sizing is a concept target. Final placement, heat and slip behavior, USB-C and charging compatibility, sensing reliability, materials, packaging and cost require physical validation.
